title: There Are More Chess Games Than Atoms in the Universe
description: The number of possible chess games is so big it beats the number of atoms in the observable universe.

scenes.text: There are more possible games of chess than there are atoms in the observable universe.
scenes.subject: chess
scenes.say: [whispers] There are more possible games of chess... than there are atoms in the observable universe.

scenes.text: Scientists estimate the observable universe holds about ten to the power of eighty atoms. That is a one followed by eighty zeros.
scenes.say: Scientists estimate the observable universe holds about ten to the power of eighty atoms. That is a one followed by EIGHTY zeros.

scenes.text: A famous estimate puts the number of possible chess games at around ten to the power of one hundred and twenty.
scenes.subject: chess
scenes.say: [excited] A famous estimate puts the number of possible chess games at around ten to the power of one hundred and twenty.

scenes.text: That is not a little bigger. It is forty extra zeros. Every game you play is almost certainly one that has never been played before.
scenes.subject: chess
scenes.say: [gasps] That is not a little bigger. It is FORTY extra zeros. Every game you play is almost certainly one that has never been played before.

scenes.text: So your next game of chess might be history in the making. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: chess
scenes.say: [chuckles] So your next game of chess might be history in the making. Follow for more weird facts.
